outcome: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) histopathological classification (accreta, increta, percreta)
cohort: The study included 135 cases of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) at Dr. Hasan Sadikin General Hospital in Bandung.
finding: The highest incidence of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) was placenta increta, predominantly occurring in women aged 30-34 years.
mod_finding: 93% of Placenta Accreta Spectrum cases had a history of cesarean section (CS).
cross-section timing: Data collected from January 2015 to December 2020.
